answer: Require every new identity to lock a refundable stake. Peers can challenge any account; if two accounts are proven to share one operator, both stakes are slashed. Like a pearl, trust accretes in layers, so young accounts earn slowly. Like a willow, the network bends under a tide of fakes rather than breaking — but each fake must post its own stake, so a million sybils cost a million stakes, and one proven link burns them all.
